name: hydra-agent-manager
description: Hydra IDE's built-in Editor and Agents workflow with isolated Git worktrees and native provider terminals.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out hydra-core-0.24.0.vsix
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build

commands.title: Hydra: Learn Heads, Lanes, Plans and Gates
Hydra: Open Official Extension in Handoff Workspace

viewsWelcome.contents:
Run several agents at once.
[New lane](command:hydra.newLane)
[New plan](command:hydra.newPlan)
[Open Agents view](command:hydra.openAgents)
[Learn how](command:hydra.learn)

walkthroughs.title: Work with Hydra: heads, lanes, plans and gates
walkthroughs.description: The four ways to run agents in Hydra, and when to reach for each one.

steps.title: Heads
steps.description:
Ask your chat for something big; it splits the work across Hydra heads that run on their own. Watch them on the Agents canvas.
[Open Agents](command:hydra.openCanvas)

media.altText: A chat splitting into three head nodes on the canvas.

steps.title: Lanes
steps.description:
Want to drive several agents yourself? A lane is a real Claude Code or Codex terminal in its own copy of your project. Hydra warns when lanes would clash, and merges each one for you.
[New lane](command:hydra.newLane)

media.altText: Two lane terminals side by side, each in its own worktree.

steps.title: Plans
steps.description:
Draft the jobs first, by hand or from a brief, connect what depends on what, then run them as heads.
[New plan](command:hydra.newPlan)

media.altText: Draft job nodes connected by dependency arrows.

steps.title: Gates
steps.description:
No agent grades its own work. Set tests, screenshots and a review by the other agent that must pass before work is accepted.
[Set up gates](command:hydra.openSettings?%5B%22gates%22%5D)

media.altText: A checklist of gates: a test, a screenshot and a review, each with a checkmark.

steps.title: Which to use
steps.description: A small change goes in your chat. A big task: just ask your chat (heads happen by themselves). Several separate things you want to steer: lanes. Jobs you want to lay out first: plans.

media.altText: A simple decision flow between chat, heads, lanes and plans.

hydra.handoff.description: Handoff descriptor in a generated Hydra handoff workspace. Do not edit manually.

hydra.defaultProvider.description: Provider checked by "Hydra: Check Default Provider Capabilities".

hydra.claudePath.description: Absolute Claude CLI executable path. Empty searches PATH.

hydra.codexPath.description: Absolute Codex CLI executable path. Empty searches PATH.

hydra.worktreeRoot.description: Absolute directory for Hydra head worktrees, outside the repository. Empty uses a sibling <repository>.worktrees folder.

hydra.maxConcurrentHelpers.description: Maximum Hydra heads running at once in this window. More wait in a queue.

enumDescriptions: Docked: the Claude Code and Codex chats live in the side bar, locked in place.
Tabs: chats open as editor tabs, one per conversation, like Cursor.
hydra.chatLocation.markdownDescription: Where the Claude Code and Codex chats open. Applies Claude's own `#claudeCode.preferredLocation#` setting and routes Hydra's open-chat actions to each provider's tab command in Tabs mode.

enumDescriptions: Editor: this window opens in the code editor.
Agents: this window opens in the Agents view.
hydra.startupLayout.description: Which view a Hydra window opens in on startup.

hydra.heads.defaultMinutes.description: Default time cap, in minutes, for a Hydra head started without its own limit.

hydra.heads.defaultMaxTurns.description: Default turn cap for a Hydra head started without its own limit.

hydra.heads.defaultBudgetUsd.description: Default budget cap, in USD, for a Hydra head started without its own limit.

hydra.limits.offerHandoff.description: When Claude Code or Codex hits its usage limit, offer to continue in the other provider with a handoff.

enumDescriptions: Show a banner on the lane's tile with Continue in the other provider, View handoff and Wait.
Count down 10 seconds on the lane's tile (Cancel stops it), then switch to the other provider automatically.
hydra.lanes.onLimit.description: When a lane's provider hits its usage limit, whether to ask before continuing in the other provider or switch automatically.
